data.one_liner: iOS‑style customizable tab bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget that mimics the iOS 13 tab bar with extensive visual customization options. It supports scrollable tabs, shadows, padding, and animation tweaks.
use_when: You need an iOS‑look tab bar that matches the iOS 13 design
You require fine‑grained visual control over tab bar appearance
You want a lightweight, null‑safe widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full navigation solution or routing system
Your app must follow Material design guidelines
You require platform‑adaptive tab bars for both iOS and Android
strengths: Supports scrollable tab bars out of the box
weaknesses: Only provides a tab bar – no navigation logic
Limited to Cupertino style, not suitable for Material design

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader set of Cupertino widgets, including tab bars, and may replace this package if you need more than just a tab bar

data.minimal_example:
CupertinoTabBar(
  Colors.black, // backgroundColor
  Colors.white, // foregroundColor
  [/* widgets */],
  cupertinoTabBarValueGetter,
  (int index) { setState(() => cupertinoTabBarValue = index); },
  {
    Key? key,
    useSeparators: false,
    innerHorizontalPadding: 10.0,
    innerVerticalPadding: 10.0,
    borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(10.0)),
    curve: Curves.linearToEaseOut,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
    allowExpand: false,
    allowScrollable: false,
    fittedWhenScrollable: false,
    animateWhenScrollable: false,
    animateUntilScrolled: false,
    outerHorizontalPadding: 10.0,
    outerVerticalPadding: 0,
  },
)
